# Gift Advisor Skill for Muse

Generates genuinely personalized gift ideas instead of generic lists: it profiles the recipient (relationship, age, interests, budget, occasion), applies gifting principles (thoughtfulness over price, experiences over objects), then proposes a top 3–5 with rationale, price ranges, a cautious↔bold spectrum, a fallback option, and a presentation idea — with a decision table by relationship type (partner, parent, friend, colleague, child). Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: it cannot see live stock or prices — you verify availability and cost yourself; the buying advice for high-tech and jewelry stays at generic caution, so don't expect specialist shopping guidance. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
